Problem Statement
Problem: Algorithms - 33
Let G be an undirected graph. Demonstrate that every cut in G can be expressed as the
disjoint union of minimal cuts.

0002 | Let G be an undirected graph. Demonstrate that every cut in G can be expressed
0003 | as the disjoint union of minimal cuts.
0004 | Definition 1 (Cut and Cut-set). Let G = (V, E) be an undirected graph. For a partition of
0005 | the vertex set V = S ⊔T with S, T ̸= ∅, the cut-set (or simply cut) associated with this
0006 | partition is
0007 | δ(S) = E(S, T) = {e ∈E : e has one endpoint in S and one in T}.
0008 | Definition 2 (Minimal Cut / Bond). A cut C = δ(S) is called minimal (or a bond) if
0009 | no proper subset of C is a cut-set for any partition of V . Equivalently, C is minimal if
0010 | it is a minimal non-empty set of edges whose removal increases the number of connected
0011 | components of G.
0012 | Theorem 1. Every cut in an undirected graph G can be expressed as a disjoint union of
0013 | minimal cuts (bonds).
0014 | Proof. Let G = (V, E) be an undirected graph, and let C = δ(S) be a cut corresponding to
0015 | the partition V = S ⊔T.

0019 | induced by S.

0021 | induced by T.

0052 | Suppose C′ ⊂Cij is a proper subset that is also a cut-set. Then removing C′ from
0053 | G increases the number of connected components. But Si is connected in G (since it’s a

0055 | edges connecting Si and Tj are those in Cij.
0056 | If we remove only C′ ⊂Cij, there still exist edges in Cij \ C′ connecting Si to Tj.
0057 | Therefore, there exists a path from any vertex in Si to any vertex in Tj using edges not in
0058 | C′. This means C′ does not separate Si from Tj, and since all other components were already
0059 | determined by the original partition, C′ cannot be a cut-set—a contradiction.
0060 | Therefore, each non-empty Cij is a minimal cut, and we have expressed C as a disjoint
0061 | union of minimal cuts.
0062 | Remark. This result is fundamental in the theory of graphic matroids and the bond space of
0063 | a graph. The minimal cuts (bonds) can be viewed as the fundamental elements that generate
0064 | all cuts through symmetric differences.
